title: augur.verdict/v0
description: The Augur verdict document. Output is sorted and stable: the same input and the same --now produce byte-identical output. alerts[] is sorted by (host, name, starts_at); reasons[] and replicas[] are sorted.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant at which the verdict was produced.

time_source.description: flag: an explicit --now was supplied; wall: the process clock (evaluate without --now, or serve's injected clock). The engine itself never reads a clock.

policy_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the policy that produced this verdict.

reasons.description: Top-level rollup: heartbeat and source state codes. Alert-driven causes are detailed on each alert in alerts[].reasons[].

seen.description: true when a Watchdog heartbeat is present in the snapshot. An empty input array counts as not seen.

last_seen.description: updatedAt of the Watchdog alert, RFC3339 UTC, or null when not seen. A silenced Watchdog still counts as a heartbeat.

severity.description: The shared verdict vocabulary. GREEN requires a Watchdog heartbeat.

reason.description: Closed enum of Augur reason codes. Shared across the top-level rollup and per-alert reasons; see docs/reasons.md. Extend only through the A0 contract.

id.description: Source identifier. For evaluate this is "file"; for serve it is the configured source id.

state.description: ok: reached this cycle; unreachable: could not be reached; stale: reached but not producing current data.

last_ok.description: RFC3339 UTC instant of the last successful read, or null when never ok.

alert_count.description: Number of alerts read from this source.

host.description: Host slug, or the literal value "unmapped" when the host label is missing or does not match the slug pattern. Raw label values are never echoed.

severity.description: Augur's classification after holds, escalation and exemptions; may differ from source_severity.

source_severity.description: The alert's own severity label, or null when absent. Never trusted: Augur assigns severity from policy.

expected.description: true when the alert is exempted (the Watchdog heartbeat or a matched hold) and never raises overall.

status.description: Alertmanager state, collapsed: suppressed covers silenced and inhibited alerts. Suppressed alerts are still shown and do not raise overall; a suppressed Watchdog still counts as a heartbeat.

starts_at.description: RFC3339 UTC start of the alert. Hold age is now - starts_at, clamped at 0; a negative value adds clock_skew.

replicas.description: Replica label values reporting this alert; the engine keys two-view rules on them. Sorted.

rule_id.description: The id of the matching policy rule, or null when no rule matched.
